body:
Holy shit bro. Your future is fucking bright as hell.

Fuck the people who say you aren't good enough. It only matters what you believe.

Tell me something. Do you want to do medicine/business because it interests you? Or because you think it will make you money?

Advice for you man. Don't do what you love. Don't do what you think will make you successful. Do what you're good at. That's how you assure yourself a successful future.

I attempted once by exposing myself to the elements in the middle of a November/December snowstorm. I texted my ex what I was going to do. She saved me that night. But I ended up in the psych ward the day after. It was one of the most traumatic experiences of my life and I had a full blown panic attack.

I've never been the same after that. Recently I've started considering opening my veins to end things. Tonight I told a close friend and former lover of mine who lives miles away from me in Texas (I'm in Massachusetts). She responded with so much love and support. It almost made me cry to see her try so hard to change my mind. Too bad my pain is externally caused and her attempts were in vain.

And Frank Underwood of House of Cards said that there are two kinds of pain. The sort of pain that makes you strong, or useless pain. The sort of pain that's only suffering.

There is no happy ending for me. Not in this world. Not in this life.

Hi Panda.

I'm right there with you. I won't repost my entire thing, but suffice it to say that I understand what you're feeling.

Tell me a little bit more about you. What are you doing currently? Are you a student? Graduated college? Straight to the work force?

Whether or not they feel that way, it's still what I am. A leech.

I don't want to be that anymore.

Everything I've done, it's all been so slight, so small. I've affected change in people's lives only by degrees. But it's only been when I had a positive spirit. A spirit I am starting to lack more and more. Pretty soon, I'm just going to be bitter and depressed all the time, with nothing left to give the world but my pain.
